text:
Zoe (Product Designer): Quick sync on the on-prem setup 'checks' screen. Idea: collapse long accordion, show CIDR + detection summary in a compact card, and surface remediation links inline. Sketch: https://figma.com/file/abc123.
Mike (PM): Main KPI: fewer support tickets for confusing failures. Can we make errors actionable without jargon?
Eve (UX Writer): Yes. Suggestions: 'Agent couldn't reach our control plane at <host>. Check outbound TLS to that host.' and for routing: 'No route to <cidr> from this host. Confirm VPC route tables or host routes.' Keep tone calm.
Sanjay (Eng - Runtime): Note: agent checks are limited to outbound TLS and DNS. Please don't imply we scanned customer ports. Use 'secure connection' or 'TLS' phrasing. Also, live probes can be slow in some regions.
Alana (Accessibility): A11y points: 1) Status must not rely on color; add icons and text. 2) CIDR field needs aria-describedby linked to format help. 3) Make the 'details' expansion keyboard-friendly.
Zoe (Product Designer): Plan: side-by-side CIDR + status card, status includes icon + visible label + sr-only update for screen readers. Move 'what we check' into an inline help panel that opens inline to keep focus order.
Sanjay (Eng - Runtime): Performance: cache successful check results for 10m, show 'Last checked' timestamp and allow re-run. That reduces repeated scans. I'll add progress states: queued -> probing -> done/failed. Typical probe <10s.
Eve (UX Writer): Microcopy for states: Idle: 'Preflight checks connectivity and required routes — typically <10s.' Running: 'Checking...' with spinner and 'ETA: ~5s' if it takes longer. Success: 'All checks passed.' Partial fail: 'Some checks failed — expand for details and remediation.'
Mike (PM): Good. For ETA, say 'estimated' so we don't promise exact timing. Also include a link "Troubleshooting" that opens docs in a new tab.
Alana (Accessibility): ETA should not be a countdown. Use polite live regions for status changes so screen readers announce updates. Also ensure contrast for the small timestamp text.
Sanjay (Eng - Runtime): Security: preflight must not include any customer-sensitive payloads. We'll only send minimal metadata and obfuscated IPs in logs.
Zoe (Product Designer): I'll update the mock and push a new frame in ~45m. Will annotate a11y and copy variants. Can folks review before EOD?
Mike (PM): I'll check remediation copy and ticket reduction impact.
Eve (UX Writer): I'll prepare a short set of alternative failure messages (beginner vs. advanced).
deploy-bot: Docs updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/onprem/setup-checks
Zoe (Product Designer): Thanks everyone — will post the updated frame once it's in Figma. :thumbsup:
